newsitem.title: USA: BancFirst says to increase number of shrs.
newsitem.headline: BancFirst says to increase number of shrs.

text.p: BancFirst Ohio Corp said on Wednesday that its stockholders had authorized the company to increase the number of shares of its common stock from 7,500,000 to 20,000,000.

BancFirst Ohio's directors had advised the increase for use in possible acquisitions, equity financing arrangements, payments of stock dividends and other general corporate purposes, the company said in a statement.
Stockholders also approved reducing the required number of board members from nine to seven directors, and eliminating the $10.00 par value per share of common stock, the company said.
BancFirst Ohio is a $1 billion bank holding company with three subsidiaries, First National Bank of Zanesville, County Savings Bank and Bellbrook Community Bank.
